Job Description
 We are looking for a Cloud Engineer to join our global IT infrastructure team and help operate and develop our AWS and Microsoft Azure environments.
This role combines daily cloud operations and technical support with engineering of secure, standardized cloud foundations, including account provisioning, networking, identity and backup services.
You will work closely with our Data Center, Connectivity and Cybersecurity teams, supporting reliable services and contributing to our global IT transformation.
 Responsibilities
 Cloud Operations:
 Administer and maintain AWS and Azure platforms, monitor service health and coordinate responses to cloud provider incidents. 
 Handle service requests and incidents through BMC, investigate complex infrastructure issues and drive resolution with the relevant teams. 
 Act as a key point of contact for the Data Center team, coordinating backup topics, resource requests and operational support. 
 Provide technical advice to stakeholders and maintain operational documentation, procedures and troubleshooting guides. 
 Cloud Account Provisioning
 Provision and manage AWS accounts and Azure subscriptions, automate onboarding and handle account lifecycle activities. 
 Manage AWS Organizations, Azure Management Groups and foundational tenant configurations. 
 Implement and improve landing zones, including account structures, baseline security controls, networking and centralized logging, aligned with organizational standards. 
 Cloud Networking and Connectivity
 Troubleshoot complex connectivity issues and collaborate with the Connectivity and Data Center teams to maintain reliable connections. 
 Identity and Access Management
 Implement and support identity integration, federation, single sign-on and foundational IAM services across cloud accounts and tenants. 
 Help define and implement role-based access control standards, privileged access principles and IAM policies with the Identity and Cybersecurity teams. 
 Support access governance processes and periodic access reviews. 
 Backup Recovery and Automation
 Operate shared backup and recovery services, support restores and contribute to disaster recovery capabilities with the Data Center and application teams. 
 Maintain recovery procedures and participate in restore and disaster recovery testing. 
 Automate recurring operational tasks and standardize cloud provisioning and configuration processes 
 Qualifications
 Several years of experience in enterprise Cloud infrastructure environments
 Several years of experience in enterprise IT infrastructure, including practical cloud administration or engineering. 
 Hands-on experience with AWS or Microsoft Azure, with working knowledge of, or willingness to develop skills in, the other platform. 
 Good understanding of cloud networking, VPN connectivity, routing and network security. 
 Understanding of IAM, identity federation, single sign-on and role-based access control. 
 Familiarity with cloud account or subscription management, landing zones and governance principles. 
 Experience in handling incidents and service requests through BMC or a similar IT service management tool. 
 Scripting or automation skills using PowerShell, Python or similar tools. 
 Structured troubleshooting skills, a service-oriented approach and the ability to explain technical topics clearly. 
 Strong collaboration skills and good English communication skills for working across global teams.
